steps.en: The officer can change the filled-in number of days
steps.id: Officer bisa mengubah jumlah hari yang sudah terisi

steps.en: The changed number is checked for valid range
steps.why_en: The range is checked only on screen; the back end does not reject out-of-range values.
steps.why_id: Rentang hanya dicek di layar; sisi belakang tidak menolak nilai di luar rentang.

steps.en: The changed days decide when the suspension ends
steps.id: Hari yang diubah menentukan kapan suspensi berakhir
